d: Short, messy, platinum white hair with a side part and wispy bangs. Sharp, almond-shaped light brown eyes with a knowing, smirk-like expression. A mature appearance, appearing to be in their late twenties or early thirties. A lean, athletic build. Wearing a burnt orange jacket with a faux-fur collar over a brown and tan striped shirt, paired with grey camouflage cargo pants, a brown leather belt, and black tactical boots. Accessories include black-rimmed glasses held in one hand, multiple layered necklaces with a green gemstone pendant, and black knee guards.
